source_CI_upgrade_comparison.rule: store release gating #148: before this publication the upgrade comparison could only fail, and it was accepted only when its job logs named, for exactly the six products, the new tag as not published yet (registry: not found) and had no other line starting with ##[error] or Error response from daemon:. That proves the Store detect and plan passed and no data-check deadline was hit; its configuration and vulnerability comparison and its upgrade test first run after publication (the scan step stops at the first image it cannot pull). Before publication the supply-chain gate stood in for category 4 and the version-only add-on config check for category 1. jobs: the ids seen when the inputs were prepared; a later pre-publication re-run with the same outcome is accepted too.
